meta.title: Business Location decides which Tax ID field is shown

steps.note: Select the Tax ID invitation method.
Set the business location to India.
Assert that India displays the GSTIN field.

args.goal: change Business Location to an available VAT country and stop on the Invite Vendor drawer showing the country-specific VAT Tax ID field

steps.note: Choose a VAT country available in the drawer and leave its tax field visible.
Assert that the tax field changes to the VAT label.
